Container.Name: overmynd
Container.Overview: Overmynd media dashboard with public playback, progress, and optional Seerr requests. Administration requires sign-in. Uses the locally built overmynd:auth-completion image; build it before applying this template. Existing settings are preserved in /mnt/user/appdata/overmynd/config.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings, and administrator account. Keep this existing path when migrating.

Config.Name: Media storage (read only)
Config.Description: Read-only media root for cached category sizes and filesystem free space.

Config.Name: Storage root
Config.Description: Container media root. Leave blank to disable public storage totals.

Config.Name: Hidden Emby libraries
Config.Description: Comma-separated Emby library IDs omitted from public playback. Uses the Emby connection in access settings for missing library IDs. Single Emby server only.
